newsitem.title: USA: North American Mortgage Oct applications up.
newsitem.headline: North American Mortgage Oct applications up.

text.p: North American Mortgage Co said its October 1996 loan applications were $1.4 billion, up from $1.3 billion a year earlier.
October 1996 loan fundings were $765 million, a three percent decrease from October 1995 fundings of $788 million.

Refinancings represented 33 percent of total fundings and 41 percent of total applications for October 1996. Loan applications for year-to-date October 1996 were $13.6 billion, up 32 percent over year-to-date October 1995 applications.
Loan fundings for the 10 months ended October 31, 1996 were $7.8 billion, up 34 percent from a year earlier.
